D\'Genius Solutions

SEO Manager

D'Genius Solutions is seeking an experienced SEO Manager with 3-4 years of expertise in SEO, AEO, GEO, LLM SEO, and AI tools for search optimization. The role involves strategy, execution, technical SEO, content direction, and performance tracking across various projects, with a focus on both traditional and AI-driven search landscapes.

Part 1: 10 Situational Questions Part 2: 15 MCQs · 3 Short Answers · 1 Long Answers ~45–60 minutes

No internet access. Answer independently.

Section A — Multiple Choice

15 marks
1Which of the following is the primary goal of technical SEO?
A. To improve website speed and user experience.
B. To ensure search engines can crawl, index, and understand the website.
C. To build high-quality backlinks to the website.
D. To create engaging and relevant content for users.
2What does 'AEO' stand for in the context of SEO?
A. Advanced Engine Optimization
B. Answer Engine Optimization
C. Automated Engagement Optimization
D. Algorithmic Experience Optimization
3Which tool is primarily used for monitoring website crawl errors and indexing issues?
A. Google Analytics
B. Google Search Console
C. Ahrefs
D. SEMrush
4What is the main purpose of keyword clustering?
A. To identify the most expensive keywords for PPC campaigns.
B. To group related keywords into thematic sets for content strategy.
C. To find long-tail keywords with low search volume.
D. To analyze competitor keyword strategies.
5Which of the following is a key component of 'GEO' (Generative Engine Optimization)?
A. Optimizing for voice search queries.
B. Ensuring mobile-friendliness.
C. Structuring content to be easily understood and synthesized by AI models.
D. Building a strong internal linking structure.
6What is the primary function of schema markup?
A. To improve website loading speed.
B. To provide search engines with structured data about the content on a page.
C. To prevent duplicate content issues.
D. To enhance the website's security.
7Which of these AI tools is most likely to be used by an SEO Manager for generating content briefs or outlines?
A. Google Analytics
B. Screaming Frog
C. ChatGPT or similar LLMs
D. Google Search Console
8What does 'LLM SEO' primarily refer to?
A. Search Engine Optimization for Large Language Models.
B. Local Search Engine Optimization for Mobile Devices.
C. Link-building strategies for Low-Volume Keywords.
D. Long-term Marketing Strategy for SEO.
9Which metric in Google Analytics is most relevant for understanding user engagement with organic traffic?
A. Bounce Rate
B. Average Session Duration
C. Pages/Session
D. All of the above
10What is the main purpose of conducting a content gap analysis?
A. To identify content that is performing poorly.
B. To find topics that competitors cover but you do not.
C. To determine the optimal meta description length.
D. To analyze the website's backlink profile.
11Which of the following is an example of an off-page SEO activity?
A. Optimizing title tags.
B. Improving website loading speed.
C. Building high-quality backlinks.
D. Implementing schema markup.
12Core Web Vitals are a set of metrics focused on:
A. Keyword density and relevance.
B. User experience related to loading, interactivity, and visual stability.
C. The number of inbound links.
D. The frequency of content updates.
13What is the primary benefit of optimizing for featured snippets?
A. Increased organic CTR and brand visibility.
B. Improved website loading speed.
C. Enhanced internal linking structure.
D. Better crawlability of the website.
14When using AI tools for research support, what is a crucial step?
A. Accepting all AI suggestions without question.
B. Focusing only on AI-generated keyword ideas.
C. Verifying the accuracy and relevance of AI-generated information.
D. Using AI-generated content verbatim.
15Which of these is NOT a direct SEO tool?
A. Google Search Console
B. SEMrush
C. Ahrefs
D. Microsoft Excel

Section B — Short Answers

3 questions
B1Briefly explain the difference between on-page SEO and off-page SEO.
B2How would you use AI tools like ChatGPT to improve the content optimization workflow?
B3What are Core Web Vitals, and why are they important for SEO?

Section C — Long Answer

1 question(s)
C1Imagine you are tasked with developing an SEO strategy for a new e-commerce website selling handcrafted jewelry. Outline your approach, covering key areas like keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO considerations, content strategy, and how you would incorporate AEO and GEO principles.
Minimum 150 words.
